spell.arcane_addon.arcane_pulse.guide: Release a shockwave of raw arcane energy, damaging all enemies around you.
spell.arcane_addon.summon_greatsword.gui: Empty main hand: summon the Demon Slayer Sword. Holding it: summon the Demon Dweller Sword into your off hand. Holding both: Twin Swap - flip them between your hands with a burst of speed. Swapping to the Dweller makes the Slayer spin a 360 degree Whirlwind cut; swapping to the Slayer makes the Dweller fire a Volley of three dark crescents. The swap strike can trigger every 4 seconds. Costs no mana.
ui.arcane_addon.empty_hand_required: Your main hand must be empty (or hold the Demon Slayer Sword) to use this spell.
ui.arcane_addon.grimoire_only: This spell can only be cast from the Black Grimoire.
spell.arcane_addon.piercing_dash.guide: Thrust the sword forward and dash through your enemies. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand the dash is faster and trails dark smoke, but hits lighter. Costs no mana.
ui.arcane_addon.sword_required: Hold the Demon Slayer Sword to use this spell.
Vanishes the moment it leaves your hand.
Heavy, slow, and unbreakable. Cuts spells apart: 35% less spell damage while held.
tooltip.arcane_addon.black_grimoire.1: Drains your mana while worn; spells cost none.
tooltip.arcane_addon.black_grimoire.2: Ten spell slots. Its power flows into your body.
spell.arcane_addon.zetten.guide: Concentrate anti magic into the sword and bring it down in one huge vertical slash. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand it becomes a fast X of two dark slashes. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.sky_splitter.guide: Drain anti magic into the blade, then cleave upward: a towering black crescent flies forward, cutting through everything in its path and stopping at walls. Behind it the sky splits open - and a moment later the rift snaps shut, cutting everything inside it again. With the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand it becomes two crescents crossed in an X. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.anti_magic.guide: Release anti magic from the sword in a wave that strips every magical effect from nearby enemies, breaks any spell they are casting, and cleanses your own ailments. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.ki_sense.guide: Open your sixth sense: for 12 seconds every creature within 32 blocks shows through walls as a faint flame of ki - red for monsters, green for passive creatures, yellow for neutral ones and blue for players. Only you can see it. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.instinct_guard.guide: Enter a 2 second ki stance: no attack can hurt you, and the first enemy to strike you within 6 blocks gets countered - you blink behind them and cut them down, leaving them slowed and weakened. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_union.guide: Liebe merges with you for 50 seconds: more attack damage, speed, attack speed and knockback resistance, devil regeneration, 35% less damage and 70% less spell damage, wrapped in black devil flame. Costs no mana. While it lasts, every spell in the grimoire becomes its devil version. While the union lasts you can fly: in the air press Jump to spread the wings and hover; W flies where you look, S brakes, A/D drift, hold Jump to rise, hold Sneak to sink; land to fold them. No fall damage.
ui.arcane_addon.offhand_empty_required: Your off hand must be empty to summon the Demon Dweller Sword.
tooltip.arcane_addon.demon_dweller_sword: Fast twin of the Demon Slayer Sword: lower damage, much faster swings.
Vanishes when it isn't in your hands. In the off hand: +2 attack damage, +0.4 attack speed. 35% less spell damage while held.
spell.arcane_addon.dweller_slash.guide: Send a projected slash of Anti Magic flying out of the Demon Dweller Sword. It cuts everything in its path, stops at walls and strips their magical effects. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in either hand. Costs no mana.
spell.arcane_addon.borrowed_slash.guide: The Demon Dweller Sword borrows magic from the world around you: the projected slash takes on a random element - fire, ice, lightning or wind. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand. Costs no mana.
ui.arcane_addon.dweller_required: Hold the Demon Dweller Sword to use this spell.
ui.arcane_addon.any_sword_required: Hold the Demon Slayer Sword or the Demon Dweller Sword to use this spell.
ui.arcane_addon.cast_broken: Your spell was broken by anti magic!
tooltip.arcane_addon.three_leaf_grimoire: Below 35% health your spells grow 20% stronger.
Faith, hope and love: the grimoire most mages are given.
15% chance that a spell's cooldown is refunded.
The rare fourth leaf holds luck.
tooltip.arcane_addon.mana_zone_codex.des: Stand still for 2 seconds to claim the mana around you: +25% spell power and +75% mana regeneration until you move.
tooltip.arcane_addon.mana_zone_codex.lor: Command the mana in the air, not only your own.
tooltip.arcane_addon.spirit_bound_grimoi: The spirit inside blocks one spell hit completely, then needs 20 seconds to gather again.
A wind spirit has chosen this book as its home.
ui.arcane_addon.hope: Hope kindles - your spells grow stronger
ui.arcane_addon.spirit_ward: The spirit turns the spell aside
tooltip.arcane_addon.dark_grimoire.desc: The first time you fall below 25% health, every spell cooldown resets and you heal 25% of your health. Once every 90 seconds.
tooltip.arcane_addon.dark_grimoire.lore: A three-leaf grimoire of Dark Magic from the Land of the Sun.
tooltip.arcane_addon.dark_katana.1: Required for the Dark Grimoire's sword techniques.
ui.arcane_addon.dark_grimoire_only: This spell can only be cast from the Dark Grimoire.
ui.arcane_addon.surpass_limits: Surpass your limits. Right here, right now!
spell.arcane_addon.black_blade.guide: Coat your blade - and yourself - in darkness for 20 seconds (a black-flame aura burns around you): every melee hit deals +6 damage and swallows 20 of the target's mana. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: every hit also cuts the next enemy in the zone.
spell.arcane_addon.dimension_slash.guide: Sink into the draw stance, then one horizontal iaido cut: a towering wave of black flame rolls 40 blocks forward, widening as it goes, cutting everything it passes through, and leaves the tears of cut space behind. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: one huge ring-shaped slash sweeps out through the whole zone and cuts every enemy inside.
spell.arcane_addon.avidya_slash.guide: A slash guided by ki. It bends in flight toward the enemy you are looking at (up to 30 blocks, must be in sight). Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: three slashes tear out of the zone's edge around the target and converge on it.
spell.arcane_addon.wild_slash: Dark Cloaked Avidya Wild Slash Raijin
spell.arcane_addon.wild_slash.guide: Sense every ki within 16 blocks and cut them all at once: a jagged bolt of black lightning races to each enemy (up to 10) and lands as a cut with a burst of dark shards. With no one around, eight bolts tear outward. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: a slash comes out of the zone's edge for every enemy inside it (up to 16).
spell.arcane_addon.death_thrust.guide: A piercing thrust of darkness 12 blocks straight ahead. Hits everything in the line and drives it back. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: the thrust comes out of the dark behind the three nearest enemies.
spell.arcane_addon.black_moon.guide: Raise a black moon above you for 4 seconds: every spell that would hit you is pulled into it in a spiral of darkness. Then it collapses and dives out as two crossed black crescents, bigger the more it swallowed, carrying half of the damage it absorbed. Mana Zone: lasts 6 seconds and breaks into a crescent aimed at every enemy in the zone.
spell.arcane_addon.black_hole.guide: Open a hole of darkness where you look. For 3 seconds it drags enemies in and grinds them, then collapses. Mana Zone: opens in the middle of the enemies in the zone, pulls from further and lasts longer.
spell.arcane_addon.mana_zone_dimension_s: Spread your mana 14 blocks around you for 20 seconds. Inside it you read the ki of every creature - bright flames, a ring at their feet and a beacon over their heads, visible through walls (red monsters, green passive, yellow neutral, blue players). While the zone is up, every Dark Grimoire move becomes its Mana Zone variant (see each spell). When it ends the zone collapses and cuts every enemy still inside.
spell.arcane_addon.ki_foresight.guide: Read the ki of everything around you. For 5 seconds the next 3 attacks miss as you sidestep them. Mana Zone: 5 dodges, and every attack you read is answered with a cut.
spell.arcane_addon.event_horizon: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash: Event Horizon
spell.arcane_addon.event_horizon.guide: Gather darkness for one second as it swells around you, then release a colossal wave of darkness: a towering black-flame front with giant crescents inside, rolling 55 blocks forward and widening as it goes. The horizon stays open behind it for 2 seconds, pulling enemies back in and cutting them again. Needs the Dark Katana in your main hand. Mana Zone: the wave is much bigger and reaches 90 blocks.
ui.arcane_addon.katana_required: Hold the Dark Katana in your main hand to use this technique.
tooltip.arcane_addon.steel_grimoire.desc: Projectiles deal 25% less damage to you.
tooltip.arcane_addon.steel_grimoire.lore: A three-leaf grimoire of Steel Magic, kept in perfect order.
ui.arcane_addon.steel_grimoire_only: This spell can only be cast from the Steel Grimoire.
spell.arcane_addon.violent_rotating_lanc: Create a steel lance that spins as it flies, drilling through every enemy in its path until it hits a wall.
Wind up, then drive a blazing lance spiralling into the first enemy ahead (10 blocks). Heavy damage, and it staggers them for 2 seconds.
spell.arcane_addon.steel_castle_wall.gui: Raise a wall of steel plates in front of you for 8 seconds. While you stand behind it, nothing from the other side can hurt you.
spell.arcane_addon.white_steel_horse_car: Steel plates fly in from all around and lock together into a white-steel chariot pulled by a steel horse, then it charges forward: the horse gallops, the wheels spin, and everything in front is trampled and thrown aside. Allies close by ride in its wake. At the end, or at a wall, it bursts apart into flying steel with a shockwave.
spell.arcane_addon.thunder_arrow.guide: Steel rails form and charge for one second, then fire a steel bolt like a railgun: 48 blocks, through every enemy in line. The recoil pushes you back.
spell.arcane_addon.acier_silva.guide: A forest of steel spikes erupts around you in three widening rings, striking and lifting enemies.
spell.arcane_addon.steel_prison.guide: Lock the enemy you are looking at inside steel bars for 3 seconds - it can't move - then the prison crushes shut.
spell.arcane_addon.knights_armor.guide: Steel plates fly in and lock onto you: for 40 seconds you wear full knight's armor - visored helm with a red plume, breastplate, pauldrons, greaves - and a red cape. +10 armor, +6 toughness, strong footing. The cape is real: attacks from behind you deal half damage. 2 minute cooldown.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_summon.guide: Devil Union: summon and swap as usual, but every swap strike uses both swords at once - the Slayer's whirlwind and the Dweller's volley together, wreathed in ember. Strikes every 3 seconds.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_piercing_dash.g: Devil Union: a faster, longer piercing dash that leaves a trail of ember. Half a second later the whole trail bursts, hitting everything along it again.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_zetten.guide: Devil Union: the sword in your main hand brings down its Zetten and leaves an ember crater - then the other sword follows with its own.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_sky_splitter.gu: Devil Union: a stronger Sky Splitter from your main-hand sword, then a second one from the other sword - two rifts in a row.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_anti_magic.guid: Devil Union: the anti magic wave, then a domain out to 16 blocks that breaks every cast again and cuts anyone carrying magic. Slayer: a crushing dome. Dweller: eight dark crescents fly out.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_ki_sense.guide: Devil Union: Ki Sense reaching 48 blocks, lasting 20 seconds.
Devil Union: a 3 second stance that counters EVERY attack (up to one every 0.3 seconds), each counter 50% harder.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_union_release.g: End the union early in one blast around you. The more union time is left, the harder it hits (up to 3x). Slayer: a meteor of darkness slams down. Dweller: a vortex tears outward.
spell.arcane_addon.devil_dweller_slash.g: Devil Union: three anti magic crescents in a row. With the Demon Slayer Sword also in hand, it finishes with a sweeping cut.
Devil Union: fire, ice, lightning and wind slashes, one after another in a different order every cast. Needs the Demon Dweller Sword in your main hand.
ui.arcane_addon.dweller_main_required: Hold the Demon-Dweller Sword in your main hand.
ui.arcane_addon.zone.open: Mana Zone - every Dark move changes
ui.arcane_addon.zone.dimension_slash: Mana Zone: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash
spell.arcane_addon.devil_black_meteorite: Devil Union only (takes Ki Sense's place). Rocket at the enemy you aim at (28 blocks). On contact a cutscene plays: an uppercut throws them into the air, you blink around them cutting through them a dozen times, then come down from above like a black meteor with one huge slash, driving them into the ground in a burning crater. They can't die until the final blow, and you can't be hurt while it plays. Miss and it ends. Needs a sword in your main hand.
